reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: The 1st Phorm app is everything you need for fitness and nutrition all in one. The premium version comes with an advisor, a real human who engages with you, customizes your macros, makes suggestions on supplements, and truly cares about you as an individual. The app has tracking capabilities for food where you can search for food items, scan a food label, or even take a photo of the meal and AI calculates the macros. There’re live streams (archived to view later) with educational information. TONS of workout programs for all levels of ability and focus, from strengthening to mobility to marathon training. It’s the best community you’ll find and no question is worth the fee.

reviews.title: Overall app readability/accessability
reviews.text: The app is great, there are some hang ups with it. I pay for the basic app of 1st Phorm. The fact I have a coach is great,  and I enjoy it, however, every time I respond to the coaches direction, my submission isn’t seen because I have the basic app. If there was a way to just use the app without a coach I would find it more appealing, I’m experienced in the gym and with eating so I don’t think I need a coach at this point in time. Another thing with the workouts, some of them aren’t written out all the way, (reps mostly) which I just guess on what I need to do and it works out for me based on the other workouts. The drop downs on the workouts I have a hard time getting them to drop down so I can fill out my reps. Other than those three things the app works great for me.

It’s usually the nutrition section that goes down. I’ve gone days without being able to use it because they want to change the scanner function or something. Just this morning I tried to log food like I do every day. Nope, out of luck. I’m tired of paying for something that continues to get more frustrating to use.

reviews.title: The only fitness coach you’ll ever need…
reviews.text:
I can't recommend Jicky enough as a fitness coach. What stands out most is how knowledgeable he is — he doesn't just hand you a generic fitness plan, he actually explains the "why" behind everything he asks of you: the nutrition, every exercise, the water intake, the steps, and your bigger goals. It's clear he stays on top of the latest training and nutrition, and he's great at breaking it down in a way that's easy to understand and apply.

Beyond the expertise, he's incredibly motivating and genuinely invested in helping you succeed. He adjusts based on how you're feeling, pushes you when you need it, and celebrates progress along the way. 

If you're looking for a coach who combines real expertise with genuine care about your results, Jicky is the one. He thinks I’m joking when I say I’ll stay a client and friend long after my goals are attained- I’m not.

reviews.title: Love 1st Phorm!!
reviews.text:
Updated 12/25/24
Ok, after about a month of not having the app, I decided to go back to it and even doing the premium option bc Coach Meg and the daily live streams keep me accountable and are my favorite parts of the app. Well thankfully I decided to do that bc when I calculated the annual billing it’s actually the same cost as the old monthly price! 🙌🏼 Sooo happy about that! Can’t wait to hit my new goals in 2025! 

I absolutely love 1st phorm and their supplements. I’ve been using the app since March and I’ve lost 40 lbs in 9 months. My Coach Meg is absolutely amazing, my husband and I spend hundreds of dollars a month on supplements bc they WORK and we love them so much. I listen(ed) to the live streams 2-3x a week, talked to my coach almost daily, logged all my food, did what I was supposed to do but then tonight when I went to log dinner I was forced to lose my coach or pay more than double what I’ve been paying per month. Why would you do this to us?! 😭I feel like I’m going through a breakup lol undecided on whether or not I’ll continue the app. I wish I didn’t have to make this decision or they could have at least given a heads up in the app… a little disappointed. Will still use the supplements though bc no one does salted PB like 1P

reviews.title: Could use some improvements
reviews.text:
Overall i think this is a great app, however, there are a few things i don’t like. On your daily nutrition tab it doesn’t show you the serving size you’ve chosen for each food. You have to click on each line to view the amount. 

The food searching list could use some work as well. A lot of times a food that i recently added isn’t included anywhere in my “recents” list and i have to go find it in a previous day to copy it. 

Lastly, the numeric scroll selections for the body measurements and water intake is hard to select the number you want because it keeps scrolling when you try to stop on the correct number.

Overall, good app but could use some fine tuning.
